briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-3 accelerate multi-agent systems as compute race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released three major models this week with enhanced reasoning and agentic capabilities. Global funding remains robust while regulatory scrutiny on safety intensifies. The AGI race shows sustained high intensity across US and China players.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with native multi-agent orchestration; Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus; xAI launched Grok-3. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B variant. DeepSeek-V4 achieved parity on key benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. NIST issued new red-teaming guidelines. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra shipments ramping to 1M units by Q4. Microsoft and Google both broke ground on new 5GW data centers in Texas. TSMC reports 3nm yield improvements benefiting AI accelerators.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI system emerge from a US lab or a Chinese state-backed consortium by 2028?
